q2_gaps: A composed path preposition ("from behind the clouds", "out from under X") where a whence-preposition stacks on a locative one — the oblique rules say a "from" PP answers whence and so takes Source, but Source with the clouds as filler would misstate the origin, and nothing says whether to join the two words into a single oblique head instead.
notes: FromBehind is defensible as the preposition actually used under the multi-word CamelCase-join convention, and Patient for the sun follows the non-volitional-natural-process branch of the intransitive-subject test.
